verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own non-production testing path: you can run the Mastra server locally, test agents and workflows in Studio, and score runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production. These amount to local dev and pre-production evaluation rather than a documented isolated sandbox. Nothing in the evidence says test runs are kept away from production data, and evals are closer to dry-run checks than to sandbox isolation. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or isolated test environment, documented separation of test data from production data or credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Studio is the interface for building, testing, and managing agents, workflows, and tools.
Register agents and workflows on one Mastra server, run it locally, and deploy the same app to Mastra Cloud.
Score agent runs against repeatable checks before changes reach production.
